info.title: EcoLoop API
info.description:
Pre-publication API contract for the EcoTroc citizen reuse SaaS platform.
Draft 5 materializes CON-06 sensitive workflows after D-163/D-164/D-182.
This is not a backwards-compatible revision of a deployed stable V1.

post.summary: Admit a durable attempt to accept the current proposal
post.description: D-182 draft.4: always return 202 with the same admission receipt shape, including for fast execution. No 201 Exchange branch. Admission is committed with plan, idempotent result and local audit/outbox before participant effects. Same key and intent replay the original receipt after current access checks, before checking the current proposal ETag. A new key cannot bypass an unresolved attempt or an existing Exchange for the root. The 60-second confirmation budget starts at original durable admission and never resets on replay. GET the attempt for its current decision and resource resolution; elapsed time, transport failures and cancellation requests do not prove a terminal outcome. D-173/D-174 preserve the unique Exchange if acceptance has won. CON-04 still gates execution before effects as execution_not_supported until real owners, proofs, clock, fencing and recovery are qualified. See docs/technical/exchange-acceptance-api.md.

202.description: Durably admitted attempt, not an accepted Exchange. Replay returns this original receipt; GET Location for current state.

422.description: Invalid admission body or D-163 consideration/quote constraints. No new attempt admitted.

get.summary: Discover private attempts in the authorized active tenant context
get.description: Participant-scoped or explicitly assigned operator scope, never all tenants from a client-supplied ID. Optional rootProposalId includes the chain history after authorizing that root. Unknown or hidden root gives the same 404. Without a filter, return only authorized attempts. Keyset order is admittedAt descending then id descending; cursor binds principal, authorized tenant and filter and does not confer rights. A new listing starts from the first page; this is not a frozen status snapshot. An empty page does not prove that a lost admission never committed. No-store, no polling of the full collection.

200.description: Authorized current attempts, paginated without private internal evidence.

get.summary: Read the current decision and resolution of a private attempt
get.description: Read the authoritative Exchange owner after current authorization, not search or a stale asynchronous projection. Same public representation for authorized viewers; permissions are not cached into this DTO. An accepted decision includes the unique Exchange ID even if participant attachment remains pending. Stopped requires every planned allocation to be resolved, including never-allocated steps. A read failure leaves the outcome unknown, never failed. Strong attempt ETag supports cancellation preconditions; no conditional GET or 304 contract in this profile. If current state cannot be established, return 503 rather than an unlabelled stale 200.

200.description: Current private representation; ETag is for this attempt only.

post.summary: Record a cooperative cancellation request, not a completed cancellation
post.description: Requires exchange:cancel-attempt plus involvement or explicit scoped delegation/case authority; reading the attempt or being a WordPress administrator is insufficient. Either participating side may request cancellation under current guardian/policy controls. Body is exactly {}. Serialize receipt admission against the acceptance decision. Same key and intent replay the original 202 before evaluating current ETag/state. For a new key, stale ETag gives 412; accepted/stopping/stopped or an already recorded cancellation request gives 409. If acceptance wins after request admission, preserve the accepted Exchange; never automatically cancel it. This protective intake follows D-127 and must not be blocked solely by a productive-work gate. Durable request and public version update share local audit/outbox/idempotence commit. Its receipt is historical; GET the attempt for the actual outcome.

202.description: Cancellation request recorded durably, arbitration and cleanup not implied.

post.summary: Refuse the current proposal as its recipient

200.description: Refuse the current proposal as its recipient; private representation with its resource ETag

post.summary: Withdraw the current proposal as its author
post.description: Proposal withdrawal, not D-168 cancellation of an admitted acceptance attempt. D-182 rejects a new withdrawal with acceptance_in_progress while the same root has an unresolved attempt. Serialize under the root gate; request attempt cancellation first and revalidate after proven closure. Do not mark the proposal cancelled, release funds or erase coordination evidence as a shortcut. Runtime arbitration remains a CON-04 gate.

200.description: Withdraw the current proposal as its author; private representation with its resource ETag

AcceptanceAttemptETag.description: Required strong public attempt version; every visible change, including the first cancellation request, changes the version.

AcceptanceAttemptLocation.description: Required relative URI of the attempt to read, identical to receipt.href. Never a cell hostname or a cancellation-success assertion.

PublicErrorNoStore.description: Required on shared D-175 application errors, including concealed resources.

CatalogNoStore.description: Required. Contextual or private representation, no caching in this draft.

ListingEditorETag.description: Required strong editor version; revalidate dependent policies and resource allocations at commit.

ListingEditorLocation.description: Required URI of the created private editor resource.

ExchangeETag.description: Required strong resource-specific ETag; changes on every public state mutation.

ExchangeNoStore.description: Required on private proposal and exchange representations.

ExchangeLocation.description: Required relative V1 URI of the returned created resource.

PrivacyIntakeKey.name: Idempotency-Key
PrivacyIntakeKey.description: Random UUIDv4 submission key. Not an identity, lookup token or access credential. Same key plus same JCS request returns the same generic receipt; changed payload conflicts without lookup.

SensitiveWorkflowIfMatch.name: If-Match
SensitiveWorkflowIfMatch.description: Strong ETag of the current workflow. Authorization precedes precondition checking; exact replay does not repeat an effect.

AcceptanceAttemptIfMatch.name: If-Match
AcceptanceAttemptIfMatch.description: One strong ETag of the target attempt; no wildcard, weak tag, list or proposal/Exchange ETag.

AcceptanceCursor.name: cursor
AcceptanceCursor.description: Opaque authorized keyset cursor, not an access token or a stable snapshot.

CatalogTenantIdQuery.name: tenantId
CatalogTenantIdQuery.description: Must match an authorized current tenant context; does not confer access.

ListingIfMatch.name: If-Match
ListingIfMatch.description: Exactly one current strong editor ETag; no public projection token, list or wildcard.

ProposalIfMatch.name: If-Match
ProposalIfMatch.description: Exactly one current strong proposal ETag; no wildcard or list.

PreconditionFailedResponse.description: The authorized workflow revision changed. Read its current representation before forming a new command; no effect was applied.

PreconditionRequiredResponse.description: A strong workflow If-Match is required. Missing, wildcard and weak preconditions never authorize a transition.

AcceptanceConflictResponse.description: D-182: idempotency_conflict, idempotency_in_progress, acceptance_in_progress, acceptance_already_decided, acceptance_stop_already_decided, cancellation_already_requested, idempotency_result_expired, plus applicable D-163 admission conflicts. No raw competing IDs, allocation or wallet details. Same-key in-progress is not a new attempt; reconcile without changing the key. Known pre-admission conflicts do not assert the outcome of a previous unknown request.

AcceptancePreconditionResponse.description: precondition_failed: new intent has a stale proposal ETag for admission, or stale attempt ETag for cancellation. Read current state before an explicit changed action. Original committed replay is checked first.

AcceptancePreconditionRequiredResponse.description: precondition_required: required strong If-Match is absent. No new admission or cancellation request is recorded.

AcceptanceErrorResponse.description: Unclassified public attempt error. Does not prove that a previous request had no effects; reconcile the same identity under current authorization.

BadRequestResponse.description: Malformed JSON, path/query parameter or required non-authentication header (including Idempotency-Key where declared). No command is admitted. Valid JSON with invalid body fields uses 422. Missing webhook authentication uses its signature-specific 403.

example.message: The request cannot be parsed or its parameters are invalid.

AuthenticationRequiredResponse.description: Missing, invalid or expired bearer credentials. On optional-auth routes, an absent credential remains anonymous; a supplied invalid credential must not silently downgrade to anonymous. No protected resource existence is disclosed.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Required Bearer challenge; never contains credential or resource details.

example.message: A valid bearer credential is required.

ForbiddenResponse.description: Authenticated caller lacks a permission or current policy denies access to this action/context. Use 404 when revealing the target would disclose a protected resource. Inability to prove authorization is an unavailable response, not a policy denial.

example.message: This action is not permitted in the current context.

NotFoundResponse.description: Resource or context is absent or not visible to this caller. Foreign-tenant and inaccessible private targets have the same safe envelope as absent targets; details and policyReason must not reveal existence, owner, state or tenant.

ConflictResponse.description: Request conflicts with current state or reuses an idempotency key with different content. Operation-specific descriptions identify applicable conflicts. Re-read authorized state before a new user decision; do not automatically resubmit with a new key or infer rollback of an earlier attempt.

example.message: The action conflicts with the current state.

ValidationErrorResponse.description: Valid JSON has invalid body fields or contextual constraints. Details may contain field paths and safe reason codes, never rejected private values, tokens, scan codes or documents. No partial mutation.

example.message: The request fields are not valid.

RateLimitedResponse.description: Admission limit reached for this request. Retry-After is required in whole seconds. It is not evidence about a previous attempt's outcome: preserve its idempotency key and reconcile an unknown outcome; never automatically reissue a durably refused D-129 command.

Retry-After.description: Required minimum delay before another attempt, in whole seconds.

example.message: The request rate limit has been reached.

ServiceUnavailableResponse.description: The service cannot currently prove the required authorization/context or serve the request. This generic response is not proof of a durable refusal or absence of previous effects. Critical mutations use CommandSecurityUnavailableResponse instead.

example.message: The request cannot currently be served.

WebhookForbiddenResponse.description: Missing, invalid or expired X-EcoLoop-Signature, or a signature bound to another installation/event. Do not expose which verification failed. This signed webhook does not use bearer authentication. Signature/canonicalization/replay-window qualification remains an integration gate.

example.message: The signed receipt cannot be accepted.

CatalogConflictResponse.description: D-164: idempotency_conflict, listing_not_editable, listing_not_submittable, submission_in_progress, advance_locked, inventory_conflict or schema_version_unavailable. No partial edit/publication.

CatalogValidationResponse.description: D-164: invalid_listing, invalid_attributes, invalid_location, invalid_media, invalid_availability or invalid_exchange_terms. Details contain field paths/codes, never rejected private values.

CatalogPreconditionResponse.description: D-164 precondition_failed: stale editor ETag. Reload and obtain explicit agreement before a changed command.

CatalogPreconditionRequiredResponse.description: D-164 precondition_required: the required strong editor If-Match is missing.

ProposalConflictResponse.description:
D-163 business conflict. Codes: idempotency_conflict, proposal_not_actionable,
quote_expired, quote_not_confirmed, quote_changed, inventory_unavailable,
insufficient_credit, funding_unavailable, execution_not_supported,
acceptance_in_progress. D-182 blocks new counter/refuse/withdraw/quote
changes on a root with an unresolved attempt, under the same root gate.
No partial acceptance. Cross-cell execution is gated by CON-04.

ProposalPreconditionResponse.description: Stale resource version (precondition_failed); reload before a new command.

ProposalValidationResponse.description: Invalid contribution or locked price (invalid_consideration), or amount_out_of_range.

CommandSecurityUnavailableResponse.description:
D-129: either a qualified, durably recorded refusal before acceptance,
or a generic unavailability that does not prove the command outcome.
The qualified branch is allowed only after scope/identity validation,
serialization with competing acceptance and durable refusal commit.
It does not close sessions or authorize automatic resubmission.
Declaring this response does not disable D-127 protective intake.
Cache-Control: no-store is mandatory on both application branches.

Cache-Control.description: Required; neither refusal branch may be cached.

value.message: La commande n'a pas ete acceptee. Reessayez ulterieurement.
Le resultat de la commande ne peut pas etre confirme.

Me.description: Global account composed with reconstructible cell profile summaries.

profiles.description: Selection summaries; each profile remains canonical in its tenant cell.

ActiveContext.description: Opaque selected tenant/profile pair, not authorization evidence.

SetActiveContextRequest.description: Target context that must be validated by its tenant cell before persistence.

isMinor.description: Derived account policy fact; the server re-evaluates it before sensitive actions.

CatalogAttributes.description: Must additionally validate against the exact contextual category schema. Max depth 8 and 64 KiB UTF-8 enforced by server.

CategoryAttributeSchema.description: Governed immutable JSON Schemas; closed property sets, no remote refs, bounded validation. Not an arbitrary client-supplied schema.

AvailabilityInput.description: Configuration only; available quantities and slot IDs are server-owned. Recurrence activation requires CAT-004 qualification.

Availability.description: Server-derived totals; recurring totals cover only the bounded materialized horizon. Not writeable.

ExchangeTermsInput.description: Requested terms; pricingMode and advance allocations are forbidden. Complete replacement on PATCH.

ExchangeTerms.description: Published effective terms; price mode and advance status are private editor data. Transactional amount comes from CreditQuote.

ListingContent.description: Complete normalized private editable content. Null and omission have distinct meanings.

ListingCreateRequest.description: Always creates draft; omitted description/location/expiresAt become null, mediaIds [], availability single.

ListingUpdateRequest.description: Absent fields unchanged; each supplied object/array replaces that whole field. No server-owned fields.

Listing.description: Public-safe projection only, even for authenticated administrators. Attributes additionally conform to the pinned publicSchema; no exact location, private attributes, price mode or raw file ID.

url.description: Public or signed URL when available for this response context.

ExchangeAcceptanceAdmission.description: Immutable durable admission receipt, not current state. Deadline equals original admittedAt plus 60 seconds. No Exchange, status or ETag is inferred from this receipt.

ExchangeAcceptanceCancellationReceipt.description: Immutable receipt of this cancellation request; does not assert stop decision, resource release or Exchange cancellation.

ExchangeAcceptanceAttempt.description: Minimal current public projection. version tracks public content, independently of SQL worker versions. accepted is irreversible and complete means this attempt's resolution, not physical exchange completion or payout. No raw proof, participant allocation, wallet, contact or precise location is exposed.

CreditAmount.description: Exact integer credit units; overflow is rejected, never rounded.

ExchangeProposalCreateRequest.description:
Full proposed terms, including on counter. Caller cannot submit participants,
credit mode, quote, advance allocations, holds or settlement instructions.

ExchangeProposalAcceptRequest.description: Current confirmed quote ID required with credits; forbidden without credits.

ConsiderationLine.description:
A concrete contribution, not a ledger posting. lineId is unique within the
proposal. Categories wanted belong to discovery, not to committed resources.
unitCreditAmount is a proposed unit price, never an advance override.

CreditQuote.description:
Server-derived immutable quote. All sums, direction and links are validated
by D-163 business invariants; JSON Schema alone cannot enforce arithmetic.
Zero net does not imply zero funding. CON-04 and D-158 qualification gates apply.

CreditQuoteCoverage.description: Protected external local supplement; not citizen payment or proof of retirement.

ratingValue.description: Accepted only when public ratings are enabled by policy.

version.description: Current case revision to copy into ModerationDecisionRequest.expectedCaseVersion.

executionOutcome.description: No business effect or durable acceptance for deferred execution.

recoveryAction.description: Explicit user confirmation creates a new attempt with a new key.

CommandRejectedSecurityUnavailableError.description:
Terminal refusal for this scoped idempotency key and request fingerprint.
Replay remains a refusal; it must never re-evaluate this key for execution.
Only the command owner may emit this branch after durable closure.
A timeout, generic 503 or upstream refusal for another scope is not this proof.

message.description: Human-readable text; never interpreted as machine state.

traceId.description: Diagnostic correlation only; not a credential or receipt lookup right.

CommandSecurityGenericUnavailableError.description: Generic unavailability; no guarantee of non-acceptance or absent effects.
